notes: Identity scrub 2026-08-05: the About card read 'A leading Historic Preservation organization providing innovative solutions and services to our members.' on a company that is a freight business in every other field, which is the source organization's sector rather than anything of Northwind's. Company 317's description now describes a freight and distribution business. The same seed template had put a mission pillar of the source organization into companies 303 to 317 (Historic Preservation, Patriotism, Membership Records, Education, Community Service); all fifteen were rewritten to match what each company is, so the next audit does not find a sibling on another company page.

routeHint: Finance -> Products -> 'Northwind Annual Membership' (product 968, route param is the product uuid, not the id) -> Prices & Options -> click the price name 'Corporate Silver' (product_price 2508, is_company_price 1, company_slots 25) to open the Edit price dialog.
